paper_metadata.title: Jet-Nemotron: Efficient Language Model with Post Neural Architecture Search
paper_metadata.abstract: We present Jet-Nemotron, a new family of hybrid-architecture language models, which matches or exceeds the accuracy of leading full-attention models while significantly improving generation throughput. Jet-Nemotron is developed using Post Neural Architecture Search (PostNAS), a novel neural architecture exploration pipeline that enables efficient model design. Unlike prior approaches, PostNAS begins with a pre-trained full-attention model and freezes its MLP weights, allowing efficient exploration of attention block designs. The pipeline includes four key components: (1) learning optimal full-attention layer placement and elimination, (2) linear attention block selection, (3) designing new attention blocks, and (4) performing hardware-aware hyperparameter search. Our Jet-Nemotron-2B model achieves comparable or superior accuracy to Qwen3, Qwen2.5, Gemma3, and Llama3.2 across a comprehensive suite of benchmarks while delivering up to 53.6x generation throughput speedup and 6.1x prefilling speedup. It also achieves higher accuracy on MMLU and MMLU-Pro than recent advanced MoE full-attention models, such as DeepSeek-V3-Small and Moonlight, despite their larger scale with 15B total and 2.2B activated parameters.

extraction_data.innovation: Post Neural Architecture Search (PostNAS): begins with a pre-trained full-attention model and freezes its MLP weights to enable efficient exploration of attention block designs (optimal full-attention layer placement/elimination, linear attention block selection, new attention block design, hardware-aware hyperparameter search); differs from prior approaches by starting from a frozen pre-trained model rather than training from scratch, significantly reducing training costs while achieving O(n) generation complexity and matching SOTA full-attention accuracy.
extraction_data.pretraining_corpus: Nemotron-CC, Redstone-QA, math and coding datasets
extraction_data.extension: PostNAS pipeline freezes MLP weights of a pre-trained full-attention model and explores efficient attention block designs (full-attention layer placement/elimination, linear attention selection, new attention block design, hardware-aware hyperparameter search).
extraction_data.research_problem: Efficient language model design for long-context generation and reasoning, addressing O(n^2) self-attention computational complexity and large KV cache.
extraction_data.application: Language modeling, retrieval, mathematical reasoning, coding, long-context tasks
extraction_data.paper_title: Jet-Nemotron: Efficient Language Model with Post Neural Architecture Search
extraction_data.attention_mechanism: Hybrid architecture combining full attention and linear attention blocks (O(n) complexity), JetBlock (linear attention with dynamic causal convolution conditioned on input); mixed full and linear attention layers, JetBlock (linear attention with dynamic convolution); hybrid full/linear attention, JetBlock (linear attention based on Gated DeltaNet), full-attention layers, sliding window attention (SWA)
extraction_data.training_pipeline: PostNAS pipeline: starts from pre-trained full-attention model, freezes MLP, searches for optimal full-attention layer placement/elimination, selects/designs linear attention blocks, performs hardware-aware hyperparameter search.
